items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Milton Buckner on the second one had made a tune for (inaudible) Ray called "Million Dollar Smile."

ctx.x: Oh, sure, I love that respect. I love that respect. But anybody else, she'd blast off. Gladys Hampton did (inaudible) she didn't want to be there. She didn't want to hear Dinah put her mouth on.

I'll give you an incident. We're in Los Angeles, and we're working out of Southgate, California, at this club out there. And Dinah has been called on two recordings. You know, she'd never recorded with Hamp, but she'd been promised to record. And every time she get to the Decca studio, whether it was in New York or Hollywood, Hamp turned it into instrumental.
